description: A sheet of paper with a blue pond painting sits on the table, with a watercolor palette to the right, a white cup and a pen above, and some small papers to the left. The left hand stays resting near the lower-left edge of the main paper, while the right hand holds the paintbrush, makes small strokes near the lower-right area of the painting, then lifts the brush and moves it rightward to tap into a color on the palette, keeping the brush as the right-hand object.
